source_uncertainties: Publisher track production method unknown; uploader label does not prove human generation.
Canonical source duration is exact retained-media ffprobe; publisher whole-second declaration and terminal credits are distinct.
Transcription direction/coding versus template clarified; synonymous example retains lysine, not spoken alanine; UUU is phenylalanine, not the initial spoken tryptophan slip.
Toy ATG/stop region is not a complete biological gene definition or functional transporter.
Lecture separate-protein cartoons do not imply independent lacZ/lacY transcription units; modern operon/allolactose/basal-expression mechanism distinguished.
JacobMonod1961 historical interpretation of repressor chemical identity is not adopted as modern fact.
JobeBourgeois1972 publisher abstract inspected for allolactose identity; no full experimental paper reading claimed.
Coding-density arithmetic does not independently support rounded80percent; noncoding complement is not wholly intergenic or untranscribed.
Million-protein-molecule scale is a lecture illustration, not a constant empirical count for all strains/conditions.
Full frame-by-frame video review and continuous listening not claimed.
